card.name: Scattered words before a noun
card.fires_on: No single word type fits. It fires on a Malay word ending (tulisan, pengarang), a Spanish word (años), "mutual" before "or shared decision-making", and "upper" in "right upper quadrant".

modes.label: Malay word endings
modes.description: Inside or at the end of Malay words such as tulisan and pengarang in a historical text.

modes.label: Adjective before a noun
modes.description: An adjective in a medical phrase that is followed by a noun, as in "right upper quadrant".

card.writes: It seems to push away words like that, this and which, and to favour a noun or an adjective phrase next.
card.plain: It fires on a mixed set of words, mostly ones that are followed by a noun, with no one clear theme.
